summary: Best bets: Bennington Lake MTB race, car-free Sunrise Road, Oakridge Alpine Trail shuttle, Tillamook Frienduro, Mount Spokane timed trail run and regional cyclocross. Oakridge forecast ~65–66°F with limited rain risk. Excluded closed Rogue Gorge registration and sold-out Silver Falls 50K. No confirmed public AIARE course/webinar or 2-Fast motorcycle track day this weekend. Nisqually entrance access closes Fri 9 PM–Sat 6 AM.

recommendations.title: Chinook Bennington Lake MTB Race
recommendations.description: Chinook Cycling race #3. Registration 11 AM; riders meeting 11:45; chili feed after.
recommendations.why: Local club race and social ride.

recommendations.title: Car-Free Sunrise Road
recommendations.description: NPS confirms Sunrise Road open to bikes and pedestrians but closed to cars; bring water.

recommendations.title: Oakridge Alpine Trail Shuttle
recommendations.description: Signature high-country shuttle descent, ~14 mi and 4,200 ft descending from Kate's Cut-In.

recommendations.title: Frienduro Halloween MTB Race
recommendations.description: Timed Fear & Loaming trail fundraiser with costumes, shuttle assistance and food.
recommendations.why: Unique event worth a longer drive.

recommendations.title: ROGUE//MOUNTAIN Timed Trail Run
recommendations.description: 2- and 6-hour run/ruck on a 6-mile Quartz Mountain Lookout out-and-back.
recommendations.why: Timed endurance option for ultra training.

recommendations.title: Cross Revolution Steel Lake CX
recommendations.description: Official CXR #2 race. Pre-registration closes Friday at 10 AM.

recommendations.title: Cyclocross Crusade Heron Lakes
recommendations.description: Race #4 at Heron Lakes/PIR. Pre-registration closes Sat 1 PM; day-of registration offered.

recommendations.title: Leavenworth Oktoberfest Finale
recommendations.description: Final weekend of 2026 Oktoberfest; Saturday Festzug parade 11:45 AM.
recommendations.why: Pair with Ski Hill MTB or a larch hike.

recommendations.title: Walla Walla Airport District Harvest Festival
recommendations.description: Harvest festival with music, makers, food trucks and tastings.
recommendations.why: Easy to combine with Bennington Lake race.

recommendations.title: Interwoven — Pendleton
recommendations.description: Western and Indigenous fashion, art, craft, runway shows and 70-maker marketplace.

recommendations.title: Silver Falls Trail Half Marathon
recommendations.description: Official site lists Sunday half marathon entries; 50K, marathon and 7-mile races are sold out.
recommendations.why: Scenic race option for half-marathon training.

recommendations.title: Spokane Mountaineers Gravel Group Ride
recommendations.description: Antoine–Newman Lake 27 mi, ~2,900 ft climbing, ~70% unpaved.

recommendations.title: Anthony Lakes Baker City Ski Swap
recommendations.description: Anthony Lakes newsletter confirms Baker City ski swap Oct 17.

recommendations.title: Gary Clark Jr. Concert
recommendations.description: Knitting Factory concert; resale ticket listings available.

recommendations.title: Chinook / Stevens Canyon Last-Season Road Ride
recommendations.description: Chinook and Stevens Canyon currently open. Nisqually access closed Fri 9 PM–Sat 6 AM; construction delays on SR123.
recommendations.why: Final seasonal road-cycling window before gate closures.
